title: The Other Corner
setup: Black has just stepped a rook from c8 across to b8, and the king in the corner has no gap left.
hint: Smothering is not a kingside idea; check which squares around a8 are still empty, then look for a check.
explanation:
## The Idea

A king on a8 with pawns on a7 and b7 and a rook on b8 is as buried as one on h8. {{Nc7#}} arrives on the only square that checks it, and nothing covers it — a rook on b8 guards ranks and files, never the square diagonally in front of it.
